name: ciso
description: Organizes work toward security certifications (HITRUST CSF, SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, CMMC or your own framework) alongside the work that satisfies them: register, import a controls list, interview, review a PR, attach evidence, audit readiness, all tracked in local HTML dashboards. Ships structural control metadata, plus verbatim requirement text only where the publisher's work carries no copyright (CMMC); licensed wording is imported per-org at runtime and never stored in this repo.
